svg.aria-label: About me: product developer, game developer, Software Engineering student at Sakarya University, GDG on Campus organizer, open to freelance work.
svg.text: Ships MVPs fast, then turns the ones that work into production systems.
Prototypes mechanics until they're fun: C#, Unity and browser games.
4th year at Sakarya University, Erasmus+ semester at Hochschule Aalen.
Organizer of Google Developer Groups on Campus Sakarya.
Freelance and part-time: websites, e-commerce, MVPs, game prototypes.
